requested: review the minimum official-route v011 Global Simplified Formal Test
forbidden: alternate loss, replay, update, or checkpoint owners
simulator, server, long training, commit, or push

review.scope: maintainability and semantic-faithfulness review of the global-test plan

source_edits.scope: test-only external fake and assertions in the existing formal driver; no production edits

report_write.scope: local formal plan, review, route evidence, and audit manifest

repository_discipline.rationale: The plan preserves owner layers, injects only cold/external dependencies, and validates at the persistent worker, replay, gradient, and persistence risks.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: The test owns orchestration and deterministic simulator IO only; production owns Oracle loading, source construction, replay, updates, and persistence.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The official Hydra main and persistent branch remain unchanged; dependency injection uses the existing worker-factory and worker constructor boundaries.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The spawn-picklable test wrapper depends one-way on production and production imports no test code.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Three iterations cross bootstrap, later student rollout, replay retention/eviction, weight versions, checkpoint reload, and process cleanup.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Only the existing independent formal test changes; no production flag, hook, private state mutation, schema, or config field is added.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: PASS is limited to R1/R2 offline composition and explicitly excludes MuJoCo, server assets, convergence, and policy quality.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Five design points have a minimum horizon, decisive witness, and falsifier on one coherent production route.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: A real 98-to-29 distillation checkpoint enters the actual gateway; production projects 98 observations into 66-state rows with 29 actions and 3 commands.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: One IDM and one Planner update per iteration are observed through production results; module evidence independently proves mutation ownership and order.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema 5, both optimizer states, counters, strict policy reload, first action, atomic residue, and disabled resume boundary remain production-owned.

residual_risks.description: A deterministic fake simulator cannot establish MuJoCo or server asset facts.
residual_risks.disposition: Keep those facts outside this offline audit and require separate authorization if later indispensable.
